mapper.select: SELECT customer_review_id AS customerReviewId, order_id AS orderId, reply_content AS replyContent, has_reply AS hasReply, DATE_FORMAT(replied_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS repliedAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM reply_read WHERE customer_review_id = #{customerReviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reply_read ( customer_review_id, order_id, reply_content, has_reply, replied_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{customerReviewId}, #{orderId}, #{replyContent}, TRUE, NOW(6), NOW(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = VALUES(order_id), reply_content = VALUES(reply_content), has_reply = TRUE, replied_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE reply_read SET has_reply = FALSE, reply_content = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE customer_review_id = #{customerReviewId}
